Heritage Property Agents are pleased to present this bright and well-presented one-bedroom first floor flat situated on Vaughan Road, SE5, offering modern open-plan living, a contemporary finish and excellent access to local transport connections.

The property comprises a spacious open-plan reception room and fitted kitchen, creating a bright and practical living space. The room benefits from large windows providing plenty of natural light, contemporary tiled flooring and ample space for both living and dining.

The modern fitted kitchen is finished with a range of stylish shaker-style wall and base units, complementary work surfaces, integrated oven and hob, sink and generous storage, blending neatly into the open-plan living area.

The property offers a well-proportioned double bedroom, finished with modern grey carpeting and neutral décor, providing a comfortable and versatile space with additional built-in storage.

The accommodation is completed by a modern shower room, comprising a large tiled shower enclosure, WC, wash basin, mirrored storage and chrome heated towel rail.

The flat is positioned on the first floor of the building and is accessed via stairs, with no lift available, which prospective tenants should take into consideration.

Vaughan Road is conveniently positioned for Loughborough Junction Station, approximately 0.2 miles away, providing Thameslink services, while Denmark Hill Station is also within easy reach. Brixton and its Underground connections, shops, restaurants and amenities are also accessible from the property.

The property is also well placed for a range of local shops, cafés and everyday amenities, while nearby Ruskin Park provides a popular green open space within the surrounding area.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
